enchantment.assortedsuits.chicken_jump.d: Lets you hover like a chicken as well as get one extra jump per armor enchanted with Chicken Jump
manual.assortedtools.chapter.suits.chick:
The chicken suit is not about protection. Every piece you are wearing gives you one more jump in the air, so the full set is four jumps.

It is not flying. It is close enough to get across most things, and to get you down off most of the rest safely.

Try combining them with the corresponding piece in an Anvil to see what happens.
manual.assortedtools.chapter.suits.lava_:
The lava suit is like the scuba suit but for lava.

You will need all four pieces to avoid burning alive though.

The Legs and boots on their own let you swim through lava as you would through water.
manual.assortedtools.chapter.suits.scuba:
The scuba suit works in halves to allow for an easier time under water.

The Mask and tank together let you breathe under water and see better than you would without it.

The Legs and fins together move you through water far quicker than swimming.
manual.assortedtools.description: Tool and armor sets for every material, buckets that hold more than one, throwing weapons and the wands that do the digging for you.
